LuLu Bengaluru is looking for an experienced Assistant Operations Manager with a strong background in FEC, Indoor Game Zones, Amusement Parks, or large-format entertainment chains.
 
 📍 Location: Bengaluru
 🕒 Experience: 3–6 Years
 
 🔹 Key Responsibilities
 
 • Manage daily entertainment facility operations.
 • Lead and supervise frontline & operations teams.
 • Ensure smooth functioning of games, rides, attractions and customer areas.
 • Monitor sales, revenue, footfall, memberships and operational KPIs.
 • Drive revenue growth and operational efficiency.
 • Ensure safety standards, SOPs and compliance are followed.
 • Handle customer experience, complaints and service quality.
 • Coordinate with maintenance, security, housekeeping and support teams.
 • Manage staffing, shift planning and workforce productivity.
 • Support events, promotions and new entertainment initiatives.
 
 Ideal candidates: Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving and operational management skills with hands-on experience in the entertainment & leisure industry.
 
🔹 Preferred Background
 
 Candidates from leading FECs, indoor gaming centres, amusement parks, theme parks, bowling & entertainment centres, trampoline parks, or large entertainment chains are highly preferred.
 
 Candidates who have handled large-format entertainment facilities with high footfall and large operational teams will be given strong preference.

🚀 We’re Hiring: MCAD Engineer (Mechanical CAD Support)

Location: Bangalore
Experience: 2–5 Years
Qualification: Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering

Key Skills:
• Creo Parametric (Mandatory)
• Mechanical 3D Modeling amp; 2D Detailing
• Sheet Metal Design, Flat Patterns amp; Fabrication Drawings
• Cable Harness Design amp; Routing
• GDamp;T, Tolerances, BOMs amp; Assembly Drawings
• PLM/PDM Systems amp; Engineering Change Management
• SolidWorks and CAD Data Conversion (Optional)

Key Responsibilities:
• Create and modify 3D models, assemblies, and manufacturing drawings.
• Develop sheet metal components, cable harness layouts, and routing assemblies.
• Support engineering changes, sustenance activities, and CAD data management.
• Ensure drawing accuracy, BOM consistency, and compliance with CAD standards.
• Coordinate with design, manufacturing, and quality teams.

📩 Interested candidates can share their updated resumes at k.kaviya@harita.co.in
